Data provider abstraction for Singulink.Globalization.Currency. Currency data packages such as Singulink.Globalization.Currency.Cldr implement ICurrencyDataProvider so that they can be updated independently of the main library.
High-performance and flexible currency support for .NET, done right 🎉

Unicode CLDR 48.0.0 currency data for Singulink.Globalization.Currency: every currency with localized names and symbols for all locales, rounding and cash rounding rules, and consistent behavior across all runtimes. The package version mirrors the CLDR version.
